subject.title: feat: add Factory API-key usage authentication

question: Should Factory Auto prefer a resolvable API key over an existing browser or WorkOS session, potentially changing the usage account shown after upgrade?
rationale: The branch can reliably support either ordering, but tests and the maintainer-authored rebase and credit commit do not explicitly establish the intended account-precedence policy.

options.title: Preserve web-first upgrades
options.body: Keep an existing browser or WorkOS session primary in Auto and require explicit API mode to select the API-key account.

options.title: Accept API-first Auto
options.body: Allow configured or ambient API keys to become the primary Auto account, with explicit web mode available for account pinning.

recommendation.title: Preserve web-first upgrades
recommendation.body: Keep an existing browser or WorkOS session primary in Auto and require explicit API mode to select the API-key account.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current Factory descriptor and most merged Factory authentication hardening, and he directly updated this PR's head.
